channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Thompson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Thompson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Falk on Michael Jordan, Mike Krzyzewski, John Thompson
item.description:
“If you think I wanted to have a confrontation with Michael Jordan -- hell, no. But if you want to have a relationship with someone like that, or Mike Krzyzewski, or John Thompson, they have to know, at all times, when they ask you for your advice, that you’re never going to flinch, you’re not going to B.S. them, and you’re going to tell them exactly what you think.”

David Falk on Michael Jordan, Mike Krzyzewski, John Thompson, May 21, 2025. Source: Sports Business Journal.

item.title: Monty Williams on John Thompson
item.description:
“It was like talking to some figure from the Bible who I wanted to meet. Around there, a lot of people called him Big John, but I could never bring myself to do that. I always called him Coach Thompson.”

Monty Williams on John Thompson, Sep 1, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kemba Walker on John Thompson
item.description:
Celtics guard@Kemba Walker:

“John Thompson – he’s a guy you have to appreciate, especially for me and other young Black African-American guys. He’s one of the guys who paved the way for so many of us.”

Kemba Walker on John Thompson, Aug 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarcJSpears.

item.title: Monty Williams on Len Bias, John Thompson
item.description:
Williams, a Notre Dame graduate, said on Monday morning.

“He was a hero for us. We had our parents, and we had Len Bias, and Len died. And then we had John Thompson.”

Monty Williams on Len Bias, John Thompson, Aug 31, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Monty Williams on John Thompson
item.description:
“It was like talking to some figure from the Bible who I wanted to meet. Around there, a lot of people called him Big John, but I could never bring myself to do that. I always called him Coach Thompson. I just knew that I didn't have his kind of backbone, and I wish I did. He was like Moses to me.”

Monty Williams on John Thompson, Aug 31, 2020. Source: ESPN.
